basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old who recently got into Reddit to connect with fellow gamers and tech enthusiasts. I live in Austin, Texas, and work as a junior graphic designer at a small creative agency. In my free time, I enjoy playing NBA 2K and exploring new RPGs like Bravely Default. I'm in a long-distance relationship and we often bond over video games. I'm usually online in the evenings, after work, and late into the night during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic knowledge of basketball games, mostly from playing NBA 2K series over the years. My understanding is mainly self-taught through gameplay and online tutorials. I also have a keen interest in technology, especially in how it can enhance gaming experiences.
